Name: Shamed
Summary: Son of Elpaal, who built Ono and Lod with their towns.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:12: Son of Elpaal, who built Ono and Lod with their towns.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shamed stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
